name: auto-merge
trigger: The owner has decided that content-only changes need no human merge, and the default branch is protected with Verify as a required check.
adds: A workflow that asks the hosting platform to merge a pull request by itself once its checks pass, when every file it touches is tier 0.
limits: The tier is computed with the rules of the base branch, so that a pull request cannot lower its own tier.
It does not know whether a review ran: the pull request body says so, and the owner trusts or samples it.
It needs auto-merge allowed in the repository settings, and branch protection; without a required check it would merge at once.
Not exercised on a real repository by this plugin's tests: they check the tier computation and the workflow's shape.
